caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular grid composed of two horizontal rows with six square sections in each row, totaling twelve squares. Each square is filled with a pattern made of small, thick, short, rectangular marks that create a geometric, maze-like design inside the squares. The colors used primarily are shades of pink and brown. The top row alternates between pink and a combination of pink and brown, with the geometric patterns forming diamond or radiating triangular shapes. The bottom row alternates between solid brown and a combination of brown and pink, also displaying geometric, radiating patterns. The grid is centered on a cream or off-white background, and the name "M. PARISH" is written in brown in the bottom right corner outside the grid.
title: Jerga (Carpet)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
